name: @epoch/adapter-aurum-chat
description: Epoch External Chat reference adapter (W042, the W029 adapter pattern) — the typed, fixture-driven reference implementation of the @epoch/external-event-bridge provider contract for an external team-chat system. INBOUND: provider message/thread/user payloads (fixtures standing in for the provider's native shapes) are normalized into bridge ExternalEvent records (W006-shaped provenance carrying the adapter identity + the exact provider payload digest; correlation/causation ids; caller-supplied instants). OUTBOUND: bridge dispatch requests become fixture delivery outcomes (success/retryable/terminal) with content-addressed provider delivery references. In-memory reference behavior: NO network, NO live provider calls, NO real side effects. Provider vocabulary is quarantined in src/provider (blocklist-tested); the adapter is isolated from Epoch kernel contracts — it imports ONLY the bridge provider contract + the adapter SDK (kernel-import-rejected boundary test).
